def: One of a breed of small terriers; -- called also DandieDinmont.
The quality or state of being stanch.
A bombproof chamber, usually of masonry, in which cannon may beplaced, to be fired through embrasures; or one capable of being usedas a magazine, or for quartering troops.
The doctrine and use of sacraments; attashment of excessiveimportance to sacraments.
The erosion of the bed of a stream by running water,principally by attrition of the detritus carried along by the stream,but also by the solvent action of the water.
A genus of extinct Eocene whales, remains of which have beenfound in the Gulf States. The species had very long and slenderbodies and broad serrated teeth. See Phocodontia.

Any one of many species of marine bivalve shells of the genusMytilus, and related genera, of the family Mytidæ. The common mussel(Mytilus edulis; see Illust. under Byssus), and the larger, or horse,mussel (Modiola modiolus), inhabiting the shores both of Europe andAmerica, are edible. The former is extensively used as food inEurope.
To insert as in a sheath; to sheathe. Hughes.
